title: Solitary Pulmonary Nodule (SPN) Malignancy risque score (Mayo Clinic modèle)
short_title: Risque de malignité d'un nodule pulmonaire solitaire (score de Mayo)
formula:
Probability of malignancy, % = 100×e^x^/ (1 + e^x^)

Probability of malignancy with FDG-PET, % = 100 / (1 + e^-y^)

where:

- x = (0.0391 × age, years) + (0.1274 × nodule diameter, mm) + (0.7917 × smoker) + (1.3388 × cancer) + (0.7838 × upper lobe) + (1.0407 × spiculation) - 6.8272,
- y = -4.739 + (3.691 × probability of malignancy*) + 2.322 (if faint uptake), or + 4.617 (if moderate uptake), or + 4.771 (if intense uptake),

and other variables are as follows:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Current or former smoker | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Extrathoracic cancer diagnosis ≥5 years prior | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Upper lobe location of tumor | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Nodule spiculation | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |

*Note: expressed as a decimal, e.g. 0.12 for 12%.

how_to_use.when:
- Patients with solitary lung nodule on chest X-ray.
- Do not use in patients with prior lung cancer diagnosis or with history of extrathoracic cancer diagnosed within 5 years of nodule presentation.

next_steps.advice: One study ([Gould 2003](https://annals.org/aim/fullarticle/716394/cost-effectiveness-alternative-management-strategies-patients-solitary-pulmonary-nodules)) suggests watchful waiting only at very low post-test probabilities (<2%), biopsy at "lower" post-test probabilities (2% to 20%), and surgery at higher post-test probabilities (>70%).

short_description: Risque que le nodule pulmonaire soit malin.
medium_description: Predicts malignancy risque dans solitary lung nodules sur chest X-ray.
